 KT takes Game 1 of the Korean Series over Samsung, 8-7
Ahn Hyun-min and Kim Hyun-soo each hit two-run homers
KT starter Daniel allows three runs over six innings
 Sports | Published 2026.11.04. 10:29:53 | Updated 2026.11.04. 10:39:37 | By Jung Moon-young my.jung@sedaily.com | Summary | Save A A A KT Wiz's Kim Hyun-soo hits a home run with one runner on first and two outs in the bottom of the sixth inning during Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL Bank KBO postseason Korean Series against the Samsung Lions at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on Nov. 3. Yonhap News kt beat Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL Bank KBO Korean Series at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on Wednesday. The win handed kt the early edge as it chases its first title in five years. Samsung, seeking its first championship in 12 years, must now look for a turnaround in Game 2 at the same venue on Thursday.
 kt entered the game after a roughly three-week layoff following the end of the regular season on Oct. 12. Concerns had surfaced that the long break might have dulled the team's sharpness, but kt answered with a blistering offensive display.
 The kt lineup erupted from the outset. In the first inning, with one out and runners on first and third against Samsung starter Choi Won-tae, Sam Hilliard's two-run double and Kim Sang-su's timely hit put kt ahead 3-0. In the third, leadoff man Kim Min-hyuk doubled, and with a runner on second and no outs, Ahn Hyun-min launched a two-run homer over the left-field fence for a 5-0 lead — his first career postseason home run. In the fifth, Han Seung-taek added a solo shot with two outs to make it 6-0.
 Leading 8-0, kt gave up five runs in the seventh, including a two-run homer by Koo Ja-wook, and two more in the eighth to see the margin shrink to 8-7, but held on to the one-run lead for a nerve-wracking win.
 Kim Hyun-soo set a new postseason record for career total bases. He singled to center in his second at-bat in the third inning and hit a two-run homer over the left-field fence in his third at-bat in the sixth with two outs and a runner on first. Previously tied with Hong Sung-heon atop the postseason career total-bases list with 149, Kim moved to 154 and sole possession of first place.
 Davis Daniel pitches in the top of the first inning during Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL Bank KBO postseason Korean Series against the Samsung Lions at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on Nov. 3. Newsis kt starter Davis Daniel pitched like the reliable import he has been. Signed in July as a replacement foreign pitcher, Daniel went 5-2 with a 2.13 ERA in 10 regular-season games. He was especially strong at home in Suwon, where his ERA was 1.16, and he delivered again Wednesday with six innings, five hits (one homer), seven strikeouts and three runs to lead kt to the Game 1 win.
 Samsung, by contrast, saw its pitching plan unravel when starter Choi Won-tae was pulled early in the third inning. Choi, who had struggled against kt in the regular season with one loss and a 6.94 ERA in two games, again faltered, allowing five runs in two innings. It was his second straight early exit after Game 3 of the playoffs (1 2/3 innings, two runs).
